description:
Browse an RS3 catalogue group. Use lookup_item for name search or get_item_details for one item's detail.
- Choose category from get_all_categories and a nonempty starting letter from get_category_info. category 24 + alpha "a" means high-level melee weapons beginning with A; # selects numbers.
- page is local to the (category, alpha) pair: page 2 continues page 1 with those filters unchanged. Reset to page 1 when either filter changes. Defaults are alpha a and page 1.
- Jagex total counts the category, not the selected letter. Advance pages until items is empty; an isError response is a failed request, not the last page. Guide prices lag live offers.
- Public Jagex reads require no auth or local cache. HTTP shares 60 requests/IP/minute by default; honor Retry-After on 429.

alpha.description: Starting letter (a-z) or # for numbers. Defaults to "a".

name: browse_items
title: Browse Catalogue Items
